title: weinmannia fagaroides var. trollii
intro: Weinmannia fagaroides var. trollii, commonly known as the "Troll's Weinmannia", is a plant species within the Cunoniaceae family. This plant is traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly for its anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial effects. The health benefits of Weinmannia fagaroides var. trollii include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and support the immune system. The therapeutic actions of this plant are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties.
